rationale: Price is at 95.7% of today's range and within $0.02 of the session high, which is also the prior day's high at $23.59 — a clear resistance level with limited upside before a natural ceiling. A long entry here offers poor risk/reward given the proximity to resistance, while a short against a stock showing strong relative volume (4.1x) and upward momentum in the last five 1-minute candles carries equal risk of a breakout. With no compelling asymmetric setup in either direction, skipping is the disciplined choice.
